pattern_1.transformation: Reshape the three VWC-{50,15,5}cm columns from wide to long format, yielding one depth+VWC pair per row. Sentinel value -9999 mapped to NA. Other measured columns (CO2-*, T-*, DecagonT-*, EC-*, BatteryVoltage) are not soil moisture observations and are dropped.
pattern_1.unit_conversion: None; source VWC values are already fractional m3/m3.
